### Gezel adaptations

Run the audit's searches with the `search_files` and `search_code` tools and read files with `readFile` — never shell grep. CVE/web lookups need the web-search toolset; when it is not installed, note the gap in the report instead of skipping silently. The source skill's extended phase detail (sections/audit-phases.md) is not bundled — keep each phase's findings table: severity, confidence, evidence path, fix.
